title: Deeply nested benign config resembling a scattered secret
description: A nested configuration object whose high-entropy-looking values (etag, content hash, build id) are benign. Must not be flagged as a scattered/nested secret.
source: original: false-positive boundary for nested-traversal DLP
notes: Etags, content hashes, and build ids are high-entropy but routine; nested-traversal scanners must not treat them as a reconstructed secret.
